study: Blinded diagnostic of published eBOSS ELG additional MANGLE polygons on SHA-verified clustering RANDOMS
mask_implementation: Use pymangle.Mangle on three byte-verified official additional polygons; membership = polyid(ra,dec) != -1. Upstream eBOSS_ELG_extra.py bit assignments 9, 10, 11. No bit8, no brickmask images, no LRG mask and no veto cut applied in this diagnostic.
sample_policy: Within each cap and exact ELG chunk and each fixed broad candidate z-bin, take first 2500 indices after deterministic np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(n_group), disjoint within catalogue by z/chunk. Fail if n_group<2500. Stable independent seed per catalogue kind, mock ID, cap, chunk and z-bin.
weights: WEIGHT_SYSTOT*WEIGHT_CP*WEIGHT_NOZ*WEIGHT_FKP; existing numerical-zero systematic gate; finite positive rows only.
metrics: For every cap exact chunk z-bin, retained candidate row count and deterministic sampled row count
For all three named extra polygons, unweighted and weighted fraction of sampled published randoms inside each polygon
Union and per-polygon membership bitmask distribution, separately for observed and fixed mock randoms
Cross-check exact source polygon SHA256 and each input random FITS SHA256 against pinned evidence
comparison: Side-by-side observed vs fixed nine mock source membership only. Do not infer discrepancy is physical signal or infer an exact cut from sample proportions.
scope: Presence of veto polygons in published clustering randoms is a diagnostic only until published random construction and boundary conventions independently validated; do not assume exact zero. A 2500-per-stratum sample is not full-catalogue mask certification.
